text: {"name":"wlc_tx_schedule","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Scans two transmit-context records, selects eligible timing candidates including repeated intervals, and then processes active contexts.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v1":"selected_time_candidate","v2":"tx_contexts","v3":"context_array_end","v4":"context_cursor","v5":"eligible_context_count","v9":"context_cursor","v12":"repeat_count","v13":"repeat_interval"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":12,"meaning":"Schedule base timestamp used when calculating candidate times."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Context state byte; the shown passes test for states 1 and 2."},{"offset":19,"meaning":"Scheduling or repetition count; values above 1 enter repeated-interval timing logic."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Repeated interval added when advancing a schedule candidate."}]}
